notes: The doubled שׁוּעָלִים are two units, each with its own supplied *the* joining the noun it determines (rule 15), the second discontinuous around *little* (rule 25); neither occurrence is marked unrepresented, since the ASV writes both phrases.
The waw of וּכְרָמֵינוּ takes the connective *For* the ASV wrote for it (rule 14), and the dative לְ is unrepresented beside a bare English indirect object while its suffix takes *us* (rule 40).
